rows.finding: UK PRTR provides annual datasets for industrial emissions and waste transfers.
The 2024 UK PRTR dataset is published as an XML document and the publication page identifies it as approximately 14 MB.
PRTR data includes facility identity and, where applicable, parent-company identity.
PRTR data includes geographical location and river-basin information.
PRTR data includes the industrial activity.
PRTR data identifies the pollutant or waste as appropriate.
Environmental release media are air, water and land.
Off-site waste transfers and their destinations are separate PRTR information from environmental releases.
Off-site pollutant transfers in wastewater are separate from direct environmental releases.
Defra aims to publish a reporting cycle approximately one year after the end of its calendar year.
Operators submit annual emission and waste data to the appropriate regulator.
Regulator quality checks cross-reference permits with operator-reported PRTR data.
Inspection and monitoring information is used to validate reported PRTR data.
Reported data is scrutinised for omissions, errors and incomplete information.
Industrial activities and pollutants are included according to legislation and associated reporting thresholds.
A facility absent from PRTR may be below the applicable activity or pollutant threshold.
For a listed facility, a pollutant may have no displayed data because its reporting threshold was not reached or no release occurred.
Facility emissions are point-source data because they can be tied to a specific site of operation.
Diffuse emissions are treated separately because their source is difficult to assign to a specific geographic site.
A pollutant may have different reporting thresholds for air, water and land.
Method class C means the operator calculated the reported data.
Method class E means the operator estimated the reported data and is a valid PRTR determination method.
Method class M means the operator measured the reported data.
Method class U means the determination method is unspecified.
The Environment Agency Pollution Inventory has downloadable annual files covering reporting years 2013 through 2024.
Pollution Inventory data covers annual mass releases to air, controlled waters and sewers and quantities of waste transferred off site.
Pollution Inventory reporting covers the whole authorisation, licence or permit, including point and fugitive sources.
PI reporting forms cover releases to air, land and controlled waters plus wastewater and waste transfers.
The annual Pollution Inventory reporting deadline is 28 February.
For incineration annual releases, preferred quantification is CEMS first, periodic monitoring second, mass balance or emission factors third, then an agreed alternative.

correction.previous_rule: Generic estimated or modelled wording was rejected before source and method context review.
correction.corrected_rule: Official UK PRTR or Pollution Inventory C/E/M/U annual air-release methods are valid. Permit estimates, design values, avoided emissions, transfers and non-air media remain rejected.

quality_gate: Only an official annual facility release to air with facility identity, reporting year, pollutant, non-negative numeric mass and unit can pass. Missing or below-threshold data is NO_DATA and is never inferred as zero; parcel attribution requires verified geometry.
